lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Well he just went in the bathroom, he got a band-aid, when he went in to get the bleach.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: What did Steven say he was gonna do with her car?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That he was gonna crush it.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Did he say when he was gonna try and do that?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: (shakes head “no”) No. He said he woulda, actually the sooner, he said the sooner the better.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: You need a break, any soda or somthin’?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: I got water here.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. We can get you a soda if you want one. Would you like one? (Brendan nods “yes”) What kind?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Coke.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Coke OK.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Before we get that, does anyone else know this?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: (shakes head “no”) No.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Has Steven told you that someone else knows?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: (shakes head “no”) Not that I know of.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: How about Chuck? (Brendan shakes head “no”) Does Chuck know?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: (shakes head “no”) No.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK, we’ll take a little break.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: And take a breath.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: We’ll be right back, OK?
